text:
marta: kicking off onboarding for gossamer-6b (fam: decoder-lite). need a quick perf intake + risk checklist before we flip to beta.

marta: ask: priority for perf sweep (throughput/latency) and quantization smoke? thinking: 1) ctx-length sweep (128/512/1024/2048) 2) batch-size sweep for 1,2,4,8 on A100 80GB 3) int8 and fp16 smoke 4) quality P0 prompts run

simon: +1. For batch sweep, let's measure median p50/p95/p99 and tokens/s. Also capture GPU %util and GPU mem.

simon: propose target QPS for Dedicated baseline: 100 requests/s @ avg 64 tokens. Devon do we have a target we should gate on?

devon: for Dedicated experimental pool, aim for 80% of current raven13b tokens/s baseline at same batch/ctx. if gossamer hits >=80%, green for further testing. also want tail latency < 300ms for small ctx (128).

cheng: add eval set: 2k prompts split across short/long/structured. run BLEU/ROUGE-ish + embedding-sim for semantic drift. we'll run automatic regression check vs prod-model (raven13b) and flag any >5% drop in embed-sim.

marta: good. I'll own orchestration. plan timeline: smoke runs tonight, full sweep tomorrow morning. need volunteers for data collection + quick analysis.

simon: I can take the batching/throughput runs. will push a perf job config to /perf/jobs/gossamer-batch-3412345678.yaml

cheng: I'll own quality/regression and prompt set.

devon: I'll coordinate Dedicated gating and infra (reserved pool) + autoscaler config.

bench-bot: perf job submitted by simon: job_id=gossamer-batch-3412345678-1. estimated run time 45m.

bench-bot: quick smoke output (sample):
```
CONFIG: ctx=512, batch=4, dtype=int8, device=A100
RESULT: tokens/s=12,345, p50=42ms, p95=210ms, p99=380ms, GPU%util=78, GPUmem=45GB
```

marta: ok that int8 smoke p99 380ms is a bit above devon target. Simon can you re-run with continuous batching disabled? also try fp16 default path.

simon: will run: `./run_perf --model gossamer-6b --ctx 512 --batch 4 --dtype fp16 --continuous-batching false`

simon: fp16 run finished: tokens/s=10,900, p50=48ms, p95=190ms, p99=320ms, GPU%util=70

cheng: quality smoke (embedding similarity): avg_sim_vs_raven=0.937. falls within 5% threshold (raven baseline 0.945).

marta: notes: int8 gives better tokens/s but increases p99. We should assess if KV cache or attention kernel differences cause tail. Also try prefix caching on common prompt set.

devon: please upload perf artifacts (perf histograms, flamegraphs, raw logs) to s3://redwood-perf/gossamer/3412345678/ so SRE can inspect. I'll open an infra ticket if kernel fallback noticed.

simon: uploaded artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/gossamer/3412345678/{int8_fp16_runs}.tar.gz

marta: next actions: (1) simon: batch/ctx sweep grid (128/512/1024/2048) x (1,2,4,8,16) for fp16 + int8, collect p50/p95/p99/tokens_s + GPU metrics. (2) cheng: run full regression eval and surface any semantic diffs. (3) devon: hold Dedicated gating until we have the full grid; prepare temporary-canary pool config.

simon: ack. starting grid now, will push job manifests and rough ETA ~6h.

cheng: ack. will kick off eval run and post summary when done.

bench-bot: grid started: ensemble 40 jobs queued. monitor: /jobs/gossamer/3412345678

marta: perfect. thanks all — will sync in tomorrow stand with a 1-slide summary. :thumbsup:
